title: Yellow Lightning Dancer
description: Three sequential poses of a female character with voluminous curly yellow hair performing dynamic dance moves against a solid gray background. The left pose shows her with a yellow starburst effect, the middle with a red and yellow explosive burst while pointing, and the right with blue swirling motion lines around her legs.
prompt: A cartoon female dancer with voluminous bright yellow curly hair, wearing a black and yellow futuristic streetwear outfit with boots and gloves, shown in three different dynamic dance poses on a plain gray background. Left pose has a yellow starburst energy effect, middle pose features a red and yellow comic explosion while pointing forward, right pose shows blue swirling motion trails around her spinning leg, chibi-proportions, bold black outlines, vibrant colors, comic book aesthetic.
